'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sokol DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Dark.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
